title: The 7th Citadel
subtitle: A post-apocalyptic narrative exploration adventure across the Collapsing Lands
tagline: Explore the wilderness, rebuild your sanctuary, survive the Threats
loreSummary: You are a former slave-gardener who has escaped the grim citadel of Necrodruid Ninidazir. Now free in the hostile Collapsing Lands, you must explore uncharted terrains, build a bastion of civilization, and confront emergent apocalyptic threats.
keyFeatures: Open-world terrain grid unveiled dynamically through numbered cards
Dual focus: perilous wilderness expeditions and Citadel city-building
Integrated Threat system offering distinct sprawling multi-session campaigns
Deck-building action resolution balancing endurance, skills, and hope

citadel_awakening.name: Debut Threat: Dadachaem's Awakening
citadel_awakening.description: The introductory prologue 'A New Beginning' followed by the complete first major Threat campaign (approx. 9 scenarios).

citadel_base_campaign.name: Core Box Chronicle (Two Threats)
citadel_base_campaign.description: The full core box experience comprising 'A New Beginning', 'Dadachaem's Awakening', and 'Drums of Desolation' (approx. 19 scenarios).

citadel_full_chronicle.name: Grand Citadel Chronicle (All Threats)
citadel_full_chronicle.description: The complete epic journey across all three Threats, including 'The Final Throne' and deep side-exploration paths (approx. 30 scenarios).

milestones.title: Flight from the Necrodruid
milestones.description: Escaping the bondage of Necrodruid Ninidazir and taking your first tentative steps into the Collapsing Lands.

milestones.title: Founding of the Sanctuary
milestones.description: Ringing the ancient brass bells, establishing a safe community bastion, and harvesting vital provisions.

milestones.title: The Slumbering Colossus
milestones.description: Confronting the subterranean rumblings and averting the devastating emergence of the primeval horror.

milestones.title: Echoes Across the Waste
milestones.phase: Campaign Phase III - Drums of Desolation
milestones.description: Tracking the maddening tribal war drums through toxic quagmires and ancient sunken temples.

milestones.title: Sovereigns of the Collapsing Lands
milestones.phase: Campaign Phase IV - The Final Reckoning
milestones.description: Defending your citadel bastion against extinction and securing a lasting sanctuary amid the crumbling continent.
